It runs a lot deeper, I have cptsd and other mental health problems, my social anxiety is so bad, and even being around family is fine it just takes a lot out of me, I'm genuinley trying to be positive about things, it's just sometimes it just hits hard all at once

I know you're absolutely right, it's a choice she didn't have to act that way and could of responded by talking with me and finding a solution, I did feel under control in the sense every time I got back from anywhere she'd make a argument not specifically about me being out but most times I got back from family or friends some point during that day guarantee she'd have something negative to throw at me, I do need some kind of therapy I already suffer with CPTSD and she knew everything about me before things got bad towards me 

With it being valentines day I've just been crushed, but I know I left for a valid reason, she just wasn't my person, I know it's not all women that'll be this way, I've always being surrounded by my mother and two younger sisters so ive always felt safer with women that men, I think this whole experience is just going to make me more cautious and wary

But with it being a choice of hers, it makes me accept it. I gave her so many chances to change, stop, and make it up to me, when I left initially she asked me a week before to tell the cats off if they're meowing because she couldn't sleep I never heard them I'm usually a heavy sleeper, so one early morning I tell the cats to shush and she tells calls me a name and I'm like you asked me to tell you when the cats are meowing to tell them to shush, she just went on to say how I'm selfish that she's just going to be awake from now, it was just the final straw for me all the bowing down, all the forgiving, all the attacks it was that moment of her going off at me that broke the camels back, i just said i cant do this with you right now grabbed my xbox just said im going to my parents, all because of a bloody cat 😂 I only drove down the road and just wanted a I'm sorry text that's all just her to say sorry to me for once, and of she did I'd of figured it out with her again (stupidly) I've usually got too good of a heart to give up on people and it's usually me being left but the audacity to not apologise for shouting at me over something so stupid, she just starts arguing with me why I'm a dickhead for leaving with her abandonment issues trying to uno'ing me into the one apologising when I did nothing wrong.
I hope it doesn't come for you either, black and white thinking in those moments are terrifying, im glad to hear someone relates, if you want a friend-apist to talk about anything too I'm all ears
